report:
Breast, left, central excision with nipple

The specimen consists of a left central excision with nipple specimen (22 g, 45 x 40 x 20 mm) with an overlying skin ellipse (30 x 20 mm) bearing the nipple. Sectioning reveals no discrete lesion (Paget disease confined to the nipple epidermis). The nipple skin is eroded over 8 mm. No discrete mass is identified.

(1-4) nipple, entirely embedded.
(5-8) margins.
(9) remaining breast.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Central excision with nipple
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour site: Nipple
- Number of blocks with DCIS out of total: Not applicable (no DCIS)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Paget disease
- Size (extent) of DCIS: Cannot be determined (Paget disease confined to the
  nipple epidermis)
- Nuclear grade: Grade III (high)
- Tumour histology:

  within the epidermis, in keeping with Paget's disease. No invasive carcinoma
